entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello... Sarah? I'm calling about an order. I think I need to return something, but I'm just so confused by the whole process on your website.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Um, let me find it... I think the email is confusedcustomer@email.com. I bought this jersey a couple of months ago and just... I'm not sure what to do.
Thank you, I'm pulling up your account now... I see the order for the Pro-Performance Jersey. What specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Well, I finally tried it on for a ride and it's the wrong size. It's just way too tight across my shoulders. I was hoping I could exchange it for a larger one.
Okay, so it's a sizing issue, not a defect with the jersey itself. I understand. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see here that the item was delivered 61 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I'm so sorry. I saw something about 10 days and got worried. Can't you just help me? I don't want to be stuck with it.

Of course. Let me double-check the policy for this specific item... Okay, good news. Since the jersey is a standard apparel item, it falls under our 90-day return policy. You are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? It's 90 days? That's such a relief. I was so overwhelmed.
Yes, you're all set. We can absolutely process an exchange for a different size, or a full refund if you'd prefer. What works best for you?
An exchange would be perfect! I'd love to get the same jersey, just one size up.

Excellent. I have just initiated the exchange process for you. I've sent a prepaid return shipping label to your email on file. Just package up the original jersey, apply that label, and drop it in the mail. As soon as we receive it, we'll send out the new size.
Wow, thank you so much, Sarah! You've made this so much simpler than I thought it would be. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
